the class has its polarity (advisor 23.11: neg — nichts, nix, wenig, kaum, weniger … «нечего / мало что»; pos — the others «есть что») + (code review chat 24.11, cleanup block 2: lists of the pair rules moved out of the code unchanged) direction-adverb — an adverb of direction right before the preposition or closing the part makes the group a direction (folgte Hagrid hinaus auf den Felsen); circumposition-particle — the word after the group's head that makes it a way (über Harrys Kopf hinweg); partitive-word — von right after it is the partitive «из» (jeder von euch); time-before-da-form — a word right before darauf / danach / davor that makes it the adverb of time (kurz darauf «вскоре после этого»), not the group of a pair; time-distance-determiner — a word before a time noun of noun-classes.json right before darauf / danach / davor that makes the group a distance in time (zwei Wochen danach, ein Jahr darauf, den Abend davor; a number in digits too, a preposition — am Tag darauf); time-duration-determiner — a word in that group that makes it a duration or a frequency, the da(r)- form free for the pair (den ganzen Tag darauf gefreut, jeden Tag daran gedacht, seit Tagen darauf) (advisor 26.11, 27.11)
